<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C9H10O5), DBE, aromatic carbon count, and the 13C NMR data (six aromatic carbons and two distinct aliphatic carbons), the structure can be viewed as an aromatic fragment bearing bromine and two phenolic OH groups, linked through an ether oxygen to a three‑carbon chain that contains two ether oxygens and a terminal alcohol. The two logical fragments are therefore the brominated, di‑hydroxy aromatic ring and the tri‑carbon di‑ol chain.</thought>
<final_answer>['Oc1c(Br)cc(O)cc1', 'OCCOCO']</final_answer>
